summary: Gate-detector honesty: never label a paid post 'entitled' from the rendered-vs-wordcount ratio alone; entitlement requires an authenticated fetch plus the per-user is_viewed field.
reason: Substack returns a substantial preview for paid posts anonymously, so a word-count ratio >=0.8 can look like a full body even when unauthenticated. internal/substack/render.go reports tier 'full' for a high-ratio anonymous read and only reports 'entitled' when the fetch was authenticated and the post carries is_viewed — keeping the full-vs-preview / entitlement signal honest.
validated_outcome: Hermetic render tests pin the tier labels (internal/substack render_test.go green under go1.26.5). A free post reads as tier full with the complete body (verified live: astralcodexten/introducing-plan-a -> access free, full body). Greptile P2 hardening (PR #1486): HTMLToText now strips whole <script>/<style> blocks (tag AND inner text) before the generic tag stripper, so embedded JS/CSS can no longer leak into rendered prose and inflate WordCount — which would otherwise skew the fullBodyRatio entitlement gate. Regression: internal/substack render_test.go TestHTMLToTextStripsScriptAndStyle (asserts no script/style tokens survive and WordCount counts only prose). Revalidated on the 4.31.2 reprint (run 20260829-151759, go1.26.7): go mod tidy/build/vet/test green across 14 packages; shipcheck 6/7 legs PASS with scorecard 86/100 A (scorecard HOLDs only on live_api_verification, which is N/A for this CLI and omitted from the denominator); gosec 29 findings, all in generated files, 0 hand-authored; govulncheck clean. Phase-5 live acceptance now records --level full (status:pass, 90 passed / 0 failed) — the 4.28.0 teach/playbook probe regression that forced the --level quick fallback is fixed upstream. All six novel commands re-verified live against both a subdomain (astralcodexten) and a custom-domain (blog.bytebytego.com) publication.
